20.3cm/50 Twin Gun Mount Modèle 1931._info:
フランス海軍の誇る重巡洋艦「Algérie」のために、従来量産型重巡主砲を改良発展させた充実の専用重巡主砲兵装です。
本兵装を集中配備することで、ライバルといえるイタリア海軍のZara級を圧倒することを目指し、開発されました。
さらに発展的なifSHS弾(超重量弾)を運用することで、仮想敵に対して圧倒的な火力を持って制圧することも可能です。
20.3cm/50 Twin Gun Mount Modèle 1931._info_en:
This is a robust, specialized main battery armament developed by improving upon standard mass-produced heavy cruiser main guns, designed for the French Navy's pride, the heavy cruiser "Algérie".
It was developed with the aim of overwhelming the Italian Navy's Zara-class, considered a rival, through the concentrated deployment of this armament.
Furthermore, by employing advanced what-if SHS rounds (Super-Heavy Shells), it is possible to suppress a hypothetical adversary with overwhelming firepower.

55cm Triple Torpedo Mount Modèle 1924._info:
トリコロールの国の艦隊、その必殺の爪として配備運用されたスタンダードな水雷戦用魚雷兵装です。
一般的な空気魚雷ではありますが、高い信頼性と実用性で、主力巡洋艦や大型駆逐艦に装備され、運用されました。
追加の二連装魚雷を加えて、複合した片舷五連装装備の艦種も！
55cm Triple Torpedo Mount Modèle 1924._info_en:
This is a standard torpedo armament for surface warfare, deployed and operated as the lethal striking weapon of the Tricolor country's fleet.
Although it was a standard air-launched torpedo, its high reliability and practicality led to its deployment and operational use on frontline cruisers and large destroyers.
We also have ship types featuring a combined broadside armament of 5-tube launchers, achieved by adding an extra twin-tube launcher!

5inch Twin Dual-purpose Gun Mount (Conce._info:
米国で開発・運用された対艦及び対空戦闘に対応できる両用砲兵装です。
本装備は、同砲を連装化、さらに薬莢形式を採用して連射性を向上、これを集中配備することで艦隊防空を担当する防空艦の強力な対空兵装として運用されました。
Atlanta級防空巡などに装備され、一部は夜戦の近距離砲撃戦でも使用されました。
5inch Twin Dual-purpose Gun Mount (Conce._info_en:
A dual-purpose gun developed and deployed by the United States that is capable of surface and anti-air combat.
This equipment is a twin-mounted version that adopted a new type of ammunition to increase its fire rate, and by placing it in a concentrated deployment, it was used as powerful anti-air armament on the anti-air cruisers in charge of fleet air defense.
It was equipped on the Atlanta-class cruisers, and was used for short-range shelling in night battles.
5inch Twin Dual-purpose Gun Mount (Conce._reading: 5インチれんそうりょうようほう(しゅうちゅうはいび)

Ship Repair Facility._info:
工作艦に搭載される修理装備一式です。
「明石」等の工作艦に搭載することで、入渠なしに艦艇の応急修理が可能です。
(小破程度の損害の艦を、この装備一式につき、+1隻の同時修理が可能です)
Ship Repair Facility._info_en:
A set of ship repair facilities used aboard repair ships.
When used on repair ships such as "Akashi", it can perform anchorage repairs on other ships without having to dock them.
(This set of equipment can repair +1 ships with minor damage at the same time.)
Ship Repair Facility._reading: かんていしゅうりしせつ
